description: Antigravity CLI; prompt-led coordination, hooks/statusLine and local agentapi bridge.
bootstrap: At startup, run `"$MV2_CLI" report --phase working --summary "starting"` (and `"$MV2_CLI" session-bind --session-id "$ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID"` if not yet bound) so mv2 connects to this session. Never guess another session's ID.
